title: No Matter How Strong the Opponent

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...A certain floor of the Tower of Luna. There, the screams of two villains echoed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ルナの塔のとあるフロア。
そこに、悪党たちの悲鳴が響いていた。

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギャ
ーッ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Damn it! Haven't those monsters chased us for long enough already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっそぉ～っ！
さっきから魔物に追いかけられてばっかじゃないか！？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: That's all because of your overly flashy fighting style, you know!? You're out there yelling "Spiresbane Blade" and all that while throwing off some crazy conspicuous slashes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまえの戦い方が派手過ぎるんですよ！？
「てんろーはだんけん」だのなんだの叫びながら、
メチャクチャ目立つ斬撃飛ばしまくって！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: It's a given that literally everyone on the floor would notice us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなの
フロア中の連中に
気付かれるに決まってるですよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I see... Then, I'll have to take responsibility!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
なら、責任取らなきゃな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'll take care of things here, somehow! You guys go on ahead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはアタシがなんとかする！
オマエたちは先に行ってろ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: No, you can't! It's obvious that things will get even worse if you were to act alone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、ダメです！　
おまえが単独行動したら、
もっと酷いことになるのは目に見えてるですよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Such a thing is...! Very likely, actually. After all, I can't tell traps apart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと……
あるか。
アタシじゃトラップ見分けられないしな。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: It seems you finally understand. Let's all go together! We are in the same boat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
理解したみたいですね。
全員で行くですよ！
あたしらは運命共同体なんです！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: The same boat... That's a nice thing to say! But even if we just run away like this... they'll catch up eventually, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
運命共同体……
なんかいい言葉だな！
けど、
このまま逃げても
すぐ追いつかれるぞ？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Remember that you're talking to a genius, right here! I thought something like this might happen, so I prepared a little something! ...A special smoke bomb! Take it, you monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふんっ！　
あたしは天才ですからね！
こんなこともあろうかと、
用意しておいたですよ！
……この
特製煙玉を！　
くらいやがれです、
魔物ども！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: All right, it worked perfectly! Let's run off while they've lost us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
上手くいきましたね！
こっちを見失ってる間に
行くですよ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Ugh?! W-Well, how should I put it... I had completely forgotten about its existence... or better put, I remembered it existed just now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐっ！？　
そ、
それはなんていうか……
完璧に存在を忘れてたっていうか……
今思い出したっていうか……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Haha! You can be so unfair, Inori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ！　
ズルいことするな、
イノリ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Are you taking issue with my clever strategies?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしのやり方に
なんか文句でもあるですか！？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: No, it's the other way around! I like your villainous fighting style!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、逆だ！
悪党らしい戦い方で
気に入ったぞ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Mm... You sure know your stuff! That's right, I'm no ally of justice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ……
おまえ、
なかなか分かってるですね！
そうです、
あたしたちは正義の味方じゃねえんです！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: I'll do whatever I can! Of course, as long as it doesn't go against my villain aesthetic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれることはなんだってやるですよ！
もちろん
悪党の美学に反しない範囲で、
ですけど！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Whew. Looks like we've shaken them off. You're better than I thought, Inori. Just as you'd expect from a future Big Boss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ。
振り切ったみたいだな。
思ったよりやるな、
イノリって。
さすが未来のビッグボス
ってとこか！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... keep the praises coming! All for this majestic, grand genius... Lady Inori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ……
もっと褒めるですよ！
この大天才
イノリ様のことを！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Well, you know? You've also been doing your share of the work, haven't you? I can praise you just a little for all you've done so far, Muimi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ？　
おまえもそこそこ頑張ってるし？
ここまでの働きを
少しは褒めてやってもいいですよ、
ムイミ。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: However! I'd appreciate it if you'd stop fighting in such a flashy manner while wielding that enormous sword!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただし！　
そのバカでかい剣で、
やたらド派手な戦いをするのはもうやめるですよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Even if you ask that out of me, I'm not really a fan of small-time fighting... This has been my style ever since I've been fighting {0} here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言われても、
ちまちま戦うのニガテなんだよな～……
{0}と戦ってた頃から、
アタシはこんな感じの戦い方だし。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm? Since you were fighting... Muimi, so you were Onii-san's enemy?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……んん？　
戦ってたって……
ムイミ、
お兄さんの敵だったんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I don't know if "enemy" is the word I'd use for all that, but... Well, it's an old story! A lot happened since then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
敵っていうか、
なんていうか……
まあ、
昔の話だ！　
いろいろとあってな！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: In that case... If a lot were to happen right now, does that mean you'd end up fighting against Onii-san?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だったら……
またいろいろあったら、
お兄さんと戦うかもってことですか？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, I told you before, didn't I? I only deal with bad guys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
前にも言っただろー？
アタシが相手にするのは
悪いヤツだけだ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: So you say... But a villain's words cannot be trusted. ...I'll remember what you said today, Muimi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だといいんですけど……
悪党の言葉なんて信用できないもんです。
……覚えておくですよ、
ムイミ。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: If, by some chance, you were to become Onii-san's enemy once more... then I'll be the first to face you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし万が一、
またおまえがお兄さんの敵になったら……
その時は、
真っ先にあたしが相手になってやるです！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I'm way stronger than you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アタシの方がオマエより、
ずっと強いのにか？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: S-Such a thing doesn't matter at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ……
そんなの、
関係ないですよ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...You've changed, Inori. And for the better, I'd say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……イノリって変わったな。
いい方にな！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Huh? Changed...? You're making it sound like you've known me for a while...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？　
変わったって……
昔のあたしを知ってるみたいな口ぶりですけど……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry, I must've confused you! But you know... You never thought about fighting an adversary stronger than you for someone else's sake, did you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪い悪い、
混乱させたな！　
けどさ。
誰かのために自分より強いヤツと戦おうなんて、
前のオマエは思わなかっただろ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You've become a kind and strong villain who can show courage when it matters most. I think the way you're now... you're worthy of the title of "Big Boss".
text_block_list.orig_text:
大事な時に勇気を出せる、
優しくて強い悪党になったんだな。
オマエみたいなのが、
ビッグボスになるべきだと思う！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: H-Hohooo? It seems you've got a fine eye to judge things!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
ほほーう？
意外と見る目があるじゃないですか！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Inori. It's your dream, right? Being the Big Boss.
text_block_list.orig_text:
がんばれよ、イノリ。
夢なんだろ、
ビッグボス！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: As if I need luck for that! There's no one else with the potential to be the Big Boss than me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言われなくてもなってやるですよ！
あたしほどのビッグボスの器は
他にいないですからね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In the Tower of Luna, the loud laughter of the future Big Boss(?) echoed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしてルナの塔に、
未来のビッグボス（？）の高笑いが響くのであった。
